title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The diagram below shows the manufacturing process for making sugar from sugar cane.
scenario: The diagram shows how sugar is produced from sugar cane in a seven-stage process, beginning with growing the crop and ending with drying and cooling the sugar.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: How sugar is produced from sugar cane
notes: Sugar cane is harvested either mechanically or by hand.
The harvested sugar cane is crushed to produce juice.
The juice is purified using a limestone filter.
The purified juice is heated in an evaporator and becomes syrup.
A centrifuge separates sugar crystals from the syrup.
The sugar is dried and cooled.
